{{Quote|I've learned from the best"<br>"Siri Tachi. Obi-Wan Kenobi. Soara Antana. Yoda himself. You don't know what the best is.|Malorum and Ferus Olin|<ref name="Death on Naboo" />}}
The [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] owned and wielded a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He used this lightsaber to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] [[Ferus Olin]] in the [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] [[Plasma Refinery Complex|power generator room]]. Eventually, Ferus Olin knocked the lightsaber from Malorum's hands with his own lightsaber<ref name="Death on Naboo" /> given to him from [[Garen Muln]].<ref name="Dark Warning">[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]</ref> Malorum leapt into the air to grab the lightsaber and summon it to him with the [[The Force/Legends|Force]], but Malorum was blinded by the need of the moment, and fell to the core. The lightsaber was most likely destroyed when the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] was blown up, as the explosion took the hangar, Imperial Headquarters and Malorum with it.<ref name="Death on Naboo" />
